context.target_users: University students using laptops/desktop computers for academic planning
context.research_basis: 210+ sources analyzing student productivity app preferences, pain points, and UI/UX requirements
context.core_principle: Unified information architecture - Overview as command center eliminating need for excessive page navigation

changes.add_quick_stats: Inline stats showing urgent items (3 tasks today, 2 classes in 30min)
changes.keep_utilities: History, Settings, Logout buttons remain top-right
changes.maintain_personalization: Greeting with student name stays prominent

stats_cards_section.current_problem: Three static cards (GPA empty, Credits 60, Attendance empty) wasting prime real estate
stats_cards_section.solution_option_a: Consolidate into one Academic Progress card with GPA, Credits progress bar, Attendance with target
stats_cards_section.solution_option_b_recommended: Replace with dynamic alerts that are actionable

implementation.when_empty: Show actionable prompt to add courses and grades
implementation.when_populated: Show insights like grade needed for target GPA
implementation.rationale: Students need actionable insights not empty placeholders

required_enhancements.add_location_clickable: Building/room info that students can click for directions
required_enhancements.add_time_until_countdown: Starts in 30min badge for next class
required_enhancements.add_related_assignments: Show assignments due this week badge on relevant classes
required_enhancements.add_quick_actions: Inline buttons for View materials Mark attended Get directions
required_enhancements.add_next_day_preview: Tomorrow first class preview at bottom
required_enhancements.add_status_indicators: Upcoming In-Progress Completed states with color coding

desktop_specific.hover_states: Show quick actions on hover over class items
desktop_specific.expandable_details: Click class to expand inline details without modal
desktop_specific.keyboard_shortcuts: Arrow keys to navigate Enter to expand M for materials

upcoming_deadlines_section.current_problem: Shows only empty state with generic Create Event button - passive not proactive

when_empty.success_message: All caught up celebration with illustration
when_empty.cta_button: Create Event remains but with context

urgency_grouping.overdue_critical: Red section top priority warning icon
urgency_grouping.due_today_urgent: Orange section Due Today with count
urgency_grouping.due_this_week_soon: Yellow section Due This Week grouped

deadline_item_structure.due_date: Formatted with urgency text in 2 days Today OVERDUE
deadline_item_structure.priority_badge: Visual P1-P4 or High Med Low indicator
deadline_item_structure.quick_actions_desktop: Edit Reschedule Delete icons visible on hover

complete_restructure.view_toggles: Next 7 days default This month All - tabs at section header

desktop_interactions.drag_to_reschedule: Drag deadline to different date updates due date

right_sidebar_section.current_problem: Static mini calendar unchanging stats basic module list

week_navigator.day_buttons: Show day name date number event indicator dots
week_navigator.click_behavior: Clicking day filters main content to show that day details
week_navigator.current_day_highlight: Bold border background fill for today

dynamic_stats.assignments_due: Show count with urgency 2 today 1 tomorrow or All caught up
dynamic_stats.study_hours_logged: Progress bar toward weekly goal 8h of 20h

quick_actions_section_new.desktop_benefit: Always visible sidebar means no FAB needed

layout_grid.structure: Two-column layout Main content 70% plus Sidebar 30%
layout_grid.spacing: Generous padding 24px between sections white space for breathing room

mouse_interactions.hover_states: Subtle background lift 2px translate-y shadow increase action buttons appear
mouse_interactions.click_states: Brief scale animation 0.98 ripple effect from click point
mouse_interactions.drag_and_drop: Visual placeholder shows where item will land smooth snap-to-grid
mouse_interactions.context_menus: Right-click shows contextual actions keyboard accessible

global_shortcuts.cmd_1_to_5: Navigate between main pages Overview Schedule Tasks Courses Analytics

keyboard_navigation.focus_indicators: 2px solid blue outline never hide focus rings

desktop_viewport_optimization.sidebar_behavior: Always visible on desktop no collapse
desktop_viewport_optimization.responsive_scaling: Use CSS clamp for fluid typography between viewports

course_colors.customizable_per_course: Students assign colors during course setup
course_colors.usage: Course tags left borders event dots calendar color blocks

dark_mode_support.maintain_contrast: Minimum 4.5 to 1 for WCAG AA compliance

critical_design_principles.principle_1: Every element must answer What can I do with this right now - No decorative components
critical_design_principles.principle_2: Prioritize by urgency always Overdue then Due Today then Due This Week then Upcoming
critical_design_principles.principle_3: Reduce navigation Show enough context on Overview to avoid page-switching
critical_design_principles.principle_4: Visual hierarchy guides attention Size color position direct eyes to urgent items
critical_design_principles.principle_5: Desktop advantages Use hover states keyboard shortcuts larger viewport for information density
critical_design_principles.principle_6: Course color-coding consistency Same colors across all components
critical_design_principles.principle_7: Empty states guide action Never just say empty always suggest next step
critical_design_principles.principle_8: Performance is UX Sub-100ms interactions no janky animations instant feedback
